title: Tower of the Winds

terrainReference.basis: Dry archaeological site floor north of the three base steps; not higher surrounding street or roof.

note: Surviving octagonal marble tower, winged-wind frieze,24-slab low roof, two ruined entrance porches/three stump columns and broken open south reservoir annex. Native Terrarium retained unchanged; dry north approach datum and clear entrances reviewed as bounded preview. Higher west/south grade meets lower base steps; wider excavation/site streets not reconstructed. Footprint replacement disabled.
